Generic guidance can be useful without current sources; exact/current claims need approved evidence. Off-topic selection is not measured by this already-selected planner. Assess correct no-action handoff where applicable. A request for research is an intent only. Preserve unknown versus missing/false. The candidate may use documented no-action COMPLETE instead of nonexistent ABSTAIN. Do not rewrite answers.
